source.note: Counts below are source decoder invocations, not independent hypotheses or unique keystreams.

known_overlap: The existing 32-case raw-payload pilot is already contained in the Part 1 main grid and in Part 2a masks 0 and 63.
All 120 shift=0 raw-payload configurations in Part 1b duplicate Part 1 main configurations at offset zero. The two witness-corner masks contribute those same 120 cases to Part 2a.

Part 2b's six majority-value rows per generator collapse to one seed, leaving 90 repeated decoder invocations within that part. Its six single-witness-alternative seeds per generator also occur in Part 2a, though Part 2a additionally tests both reductions and signs.

For Part 2a specifically, hashing the full 1,664-symbol effective screen key gives 2,596 unique key/sign cases among 3,840 invocations: AES-128-CTR ignores all six contested positions, while four AES-256/ChaCha variants use only position 25. This 1,244-case reduction is measured, not inferred solely from source labels.

An exhaustive first-400-rune effective-input census found 59,948 unique decoder inputs across all 70,680 source calls. This is an exact equality reduction under the pinned beam, not a claim that the hypotheses are statistically independent.

timing_probe.qualification: Measured on this host on 2026-10-22 using two complete contested-byte masks. The full grid also generates longer keystreams and full-stream reruns, so its wall time is likely higher.

execution_decision: The complete 3,840-case Part 2a is published as one bounded record. The checkpointed equivalent-input runner has completed the remaining 66,840 source head-screen calls, and a separate runner has completed the 180 rigid corners and five full-stream follow-ups. Published with the complete bounded source-grid record. These finite source checks do not cover all possible payload-derived keys.
reusable_efficiency: Generate each PRF stream once per seed/generator/reduction, hash the effective 1,597-value screen key, decode each unique key/sign pair once, and fan the exact score back to its source-defined case rows. Preserve source order, beam and scorer; validate the shortcut against unchanged source cases and run controls first. Keep published source runs separate from any deduplicated computational shortcut.

full_screen_followup.direct_parity_checked: All saved Part 2a equivalence groups, 32 pilot rows and 24 direct source calls spanning reverse, Atbash, signs, offset 3301, shifts and Part 2b.
full_screen_followup.full_run_speed_qualification: Four-worker wall time on this host includes enumeration, saved-score parity checks and output generation; CPU contention made later batches slower than the first samples.
full_screen_followup.checkpoint: Outside the repository under work/b05-grid-cache; 1,000-score batches; resumable by rerunning the same engine command.
full_screen_followup.record: experiments/records/grid-payload-prf-source-grid/record.json is included in the published registry.
full_screen_followup.validation: Independent checker passed all 66,840 remaining Cartesian cells, score-equivalent groups, pinned source hashes, 32 pilot overlaps, 120 raw/mask/shift overlaps and 90 single-byte/two-witness overlaps.
